data.name: IDS_HOW_TO_PLAY_BEACONS
data.value: {*T3*}HOW TO PLAY : BEACONS{*ETW*}{*B*}{*B*} Active Beacons project a bright beam of light into the sky and grant powers to nearby players.{*B*} They are crafted with Glass, Obsidian and Nether Stars, which can be obtained by defeating the Wither.{*B*}{*B*} Beacons must be placed so that they are in sunlight during the day. Beacons must be placed on Pyramids of Iron, Gold, Emerald or Diamond.{*B*} The material the Beacon is placed on has no effect on the power of the Beacon.{*B*}{*B*} In the Beacon menu you can select one primary power for your Beacon. The more tiers your pyramid has the more powers you will have to choose from.{*B*} A Beacon on a pyramid with at least four tiers also gives the option of either the Regeneration secondary power or a stronger primary power.{*B*}{*B*} To set the powers of your Beacon you must sacrifice an Emerald, Diamond, Gold or Iron Ingot in the payment slot.{*B*} Once set, the powers will emanate from the Beacon indefinitely.{*B*}

data.name: IDS_HOW_TO_PLAY_DROPPERS
data.value: {*T3*}HOW TO PLAY : DROPPERS{*ETW*}{*B*}{*B*} When powered by Redstone, Droppers will drop a single random item contained within them onto the ground. Kullanın: {*CONTROLLER_ACTION_USE*} to open the Dropper and then you can load the Dropper with items from your inventory.{*B*} If the Dropper is facing a Chest or another type of Container, the item will be placed into that instead. Long chains of Droppers can be constructed to transport items over a distance, but for this to work they will have to be alternately powered on and off.

data.name: IDS_HOW_TO_PLAY_FIREWORKS
data.value: {*T3*}NASIL OYNANIR : HAVAI FIŞEKLER{*ETW*}{*B*}{*B*} Havai Fişekler elde fırlatılabilen veya Fırlatıcılardan ateşlenebilen dekoratif eşyalardır. Kağıt, Barut ve isteğe bağlı olarak Havai Fişek Yıldızları kullanılarak üretilirler.{*B*} Havai Fişek Yıldızlarının renkleri, şekilleri, boyutları ve efektleri üretim sırasında ek malzemeler eklenerek özelleştirilebilir.

data.name: IDS_HOW_TO_PLAY_HOPPERS
data.value: {*T3*}NASIL OYNANIR : HUNILER{*ETW*}{*B*}{*B*} Huniler kaplardan eşya almak veya kaplara eşya koymak ve üzerlerine atılan eşyaları otomatik olarak toplamak için kullanılır.{*B*} Sandıklara, Fırınlara, Fırlatıcılara, Bırakıcılara ve Maden Arabalarına bağlanabilirler.

data.name: IDS_HOW_TO_PLAY_HORSES
data.value: {*T3*}NASIL OYNANIR : ATLAR{*ETW*}{*B*}{*B*} Atlar ve Eşekler genellikle açık ovalarda bulunur. Katırlar ise Eşek ile Atın çiftleşmesinden doğar.{*B*} Yetişkin Atlar, Eşekler ve Katırlar evcilleştirildikten sonra üzerlerine binilebilir. Sadece Atlara zırh takılabilir, Eşek ve Katırlara ise eşya taşımak için sandık eklenebilir.

data.value: The colors, fade, shape, size, and effects (such as trails and twinkles) of Firework Stars can be customized by including additional ingredients when crafting.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_ADV_COLOUR
data.value: The Dye will set the color of the explosion of the Firework Star.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_ADV_EFFECT
data.value: A trail or a twinkle can be added using Diamonds or Glowstone Dust.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_ADV_FADE
data.value: After a Firework Star has been crafted, you can set the fade color of the Firework Star by crafting it with Dye.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_ADV_SHAPE
data.value: The shape of the Firework Star is set by adding either a Fire Charge, Gold Nugget, Feather or Mob Head.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_ADV_START
data.value: Firework Stars can be crafted by placing Gunpowder and Dye into the crafting grid.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_BASIC_CRAFT
data.value: You can then take the crafted Firework out of the output slot when you wish üretmek için it.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_BASIC_HEIGHT
data.value: Filling more slots in the crafting grid with Gunpowder will increase the height at which all the Firework Stars will explode.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_BASIC_STARS
data.value: You can optionally place multiple Firework Stars in the crafting grid to add them to the Firework.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_BASIC_START
data.value: To craft a Firework, place Gunpowder and Paper in the 3x3 crafting grid that is shown above your inventory.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_MENU_OVERVIEW
data.value: This is the Firework interface, which you can use üretmek için Fireworks and Firework Stars.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_OVERVIEW
data.value: Contained within the chests here there are various items used in the creation of FIREWORKS!

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_FIREWORK_PURPOSE
data.value: Fireworks are decorative items that can be launched by hand or from Dispensers. They are crafted using Paper, Gunpowder and optionally a number of Firework Stars.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HOPPER_AREA
data.value: There are various useful Hopper layouts for you to see and experiment with in this room.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HOPPER_CONTAINERS
data.value: They can affect Brewing Stands, Chests, Dispensers, Droppers, Kazcarts with Chests, Kazcarts with Hoppers, as well as other Hoppers.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HOPPER_MECHANICS
data.value: Hoppers will continuously attempt to suck items out of suitable container placed above them. It will also attempt to insert stored items into an output container.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HOPPER_OUTPUT
data.value: A Hopper points in the direction it tries to output items. To make a Hopper point to a particular block, place the Hopper against that block whilst sneaking.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HOPPER_PURPOSE
data.value: Hoppers are used to insert or remove items from containers, and to automatically pick-up items thrown into them.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HOPPER_REDSTONE
data.value: However if a Hopper is powered by Redstone it will become inactive and stop both sucking and inserting items.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_AREA
data.value: You can try to tame the Horses and Donkeys here, and there are Saddles, Horse Armor and other useful items for Horses in chests around here too.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_BREEDING
data.value: Horses and Donkeys (but not Mules) can be bred like other animals using Golden Apples or Golden Carrots. Foals will grow into adult horses over time, although feeding them wheat or hay will speed this up.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_INTRO
data.value: Horses and Donkeys are found mainly in open plains. Mules can be bred from a Donkey and a Horse, but are infertile themselves.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_MENU_EQUIPMENT
data.value: Saddle your Horse by placing a Saddle in the saddle slot. Horses can be given armor by placing Horse Armor in the armor slot.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_MENU_LAYOUT
data.value: The horse inventory allows you to transfer, or equip items to your Horse, Donkey or Mule.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_MENU_OVERVIEW
data.value: This is the horse inventory interface.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_MENU_SADDLEBAGS
data.value: You can also transfer items between your own inventory and the saddlebags strapped to Donkeys and Mules in this menu.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_PURPOSE
data.value: All adult Horses, Donkeys and Mules can be ridden. However only Horses can be armored, and only Mules and Donkeys may be equipped with saddlebags for transporting items.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_RIDE
data.value: Try to ride this horse now. Kullanın: {*CONTROLLER_ACTION_USE*} with no items or tools in your hand to mount it.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_SADDLEBAGS
data.value: Tame Donkeys and Mules can be given saddlebags by attaching a chest. These bags can be accessed whilst riding or when sneaking.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_SADDLES
data.value: To steer a horse they must then be equipped with a saddle, which can be bought from villagers or found inside chests hidden in the world.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_TAMING
data.value: Horses, Donkeys and Mules must be tamed before they can be used. A horse is tamed by attempting to ride it, and managing to stay on the horse while it attempts to throw the rider off.

data.name: IDS_TUTORIAL_TASK_HORSE_TAMING2
data.value: When tamed Love Hearts will appear around them and they will no longer buck the player off.
